coverage.name: Montezuma County
limitations: Read all four official sample ballot styles (scanned PDFs, read from page images).
Excluded: County Ballot Measure 1A (removes term limits for the Assessor, Clerk and Recorder, Surveyor and Treasurer). Not housing.

Excluded: County Lodging Tax Question 1B (county lodging tax from 2% to 5%, outside Cortez). Revenue is designated for tourism promotion and marketing, recreation, visitor infrastructure, destination development, tourism resiliency and administration, with no housing designation.
No separate local TABOR notice was posted as of 2026-09-26.

coverage.name: Cortez (city)
limitations: Participating: City of Cortez Ballot Question 2A appears on sample ballot Style 1. The city clerk's elections page lists the same single November question (Ordinance No. 1375, Series 2026).

Excluded: 2A (city lodgers' tax from 2% to 6%). Revenue is designated for tourism marketing, economic development and redevelopment of properties and infrastructure, and arts and cultural events, with no housing designation.

coverage.name: Dolores (town)
limitations: No participating-entities list for the county was posted as of 2026-09-26. None of the four official sample ballot styles, which together cover all precincts, carries a Town of Dolores question. The town's elections page shows only its April 7, 2026 election.

coverage.name: Mancos (town)
limitations: Participating: Town of Mancos Ballot Question 2B appears on sample ballot Style 3.
Excluded: 2B (additional town sales tax of .40% for street improvements and broadband). Not housing.
The town clerk's own site could not be reached from the research environment on 2026-09-26; the review rests on the county sample ballot.
